items.title: Award: BCU-FTS-59576 Cellular Pathology Reagent Delivery and Collection
items.summary: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board. Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board (BCUHB) Cellular Pathology routinely uses substantial volumes of Formalin, Xylene, and other specialised reagents in the histological preparation and analysis of tissue specimens.

items.title: East Kent Hospitals University NHS Foundation Trust — Pathology Archive Storage Capability Assessment (C481297)
items.summary: The Authority wishes to gain a comprehensive understanding of the current pathology archive storage and retrieval market, including available suppliers, service models and potential future opportunities. Responses by 28/10/2026 12:00.

items.title: bioMérieux holds £1.29m bridging contract for Dorset's microbiology pathology service
items.summary: University Hospitals Dorset NHS Foundation Trust has directly awarded bioMérieux a two-year, £1,285,884 contract to continue its Pathology Managed Service for Microbiology while the Southern Counties Pathology network implements the new Molecular Diagnostics Lot 5.
